$description: Stacking-order (z-index) scale for Mission Platform. A shared, intentional ordering for overlay components so drawers, navbars, menus, modals, popovers and toasts never fight unpredictably with ad-hoc magic numbers.

z-index.$description: Named stacking levels, ascending. Use these instead of magic numbers so overlapping surfaces layer predictably.

raised.$description: 1 — slightly raised in-flow elements (e.g. hovered cells).

overlay.$description: 1200 — scrims / backdrops behind dialogs and drawers.

popover.$description: 1400 — popovers and menus that must sit above modals.
